obernants.operator: Retain all traces, metadata, rows and Item lists sharing the observed reply, accounting and labels. Row k plus the same batch recovers Item k-1; ledger cardinality alone cannot recover accepted rows or text. Full, partial and duplicate answers can share usage and attempted counts. Unchanged ledger bytes admit multiple failure histories; event decoding and label parsing lose spellings and discarded events.

obernants.operator: The supplied adapter evaluates decode_events with ? before interpret/append/gate. A prior valid ledger is byte-identical after failed suffix, failed prefix with valid suffix, repeated successful trace, or error prefix with valid suffix. Failure histories have nonunique unchanged-ledger preimages. This sequential adapter property is not atomicity, process execution, durability or concurrency evidence.
